summary: CapsoVision filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a $18.0M registered direct offering of 3,163,444 common shares at $5.69 per share to existing stockholders, including Star One Global Capital Limited and Eliyahou Harari, both >5% holders in related-person transactions. The price reflects an approximate 5% discount to the September 16, 2026 Nasdaq close of $5.99. No underwriter or placement agent is involved, so gross proceeds are $18.0M and net proceeds roughly $17.83M. Closing is expected on or about September 18, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown by an issuer, not a special situation.
